title: docs(demo): add new example to illustrate the algolia ris tutorial
body:
![demo-react](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6885378/21932915/41213c7e-d9a3-11e6-8d3d-2e187029e50b.gif)

This is the demo that will illustrate our React InstantSearch tutorial on the Algolia documentation website.

Some comments:

* I replaced the button that was clearing the facets and the query by our `<ClearAll/>` widget that only clear the facets. I added a note to discuss about adding another widget that will do both. Otherwise we should probably go for a connector here (but that's not that simple anymore).
* I used the `rc-slider` component for the range. It allowed me to have tooltip out of the box.
